source.text: וַיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֛ח אֶת־גַּ֥ת וּבְנֹתֶ֖יהָ מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was after thus, and struck David [the] Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its daughters from [the] hand of [the] Philistines.

en.L: And it was after this, and David struck the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its daughters from [the] hand of the Philistines.
en.B: Some time after this, David defeated the Philistines and brought them under his control. He took Gath and its villages out of the Philistines' hands.
en.R: Later David defeated the Philistines and made them give in to him. He took Gath and the villages around it away from the Philistines.

es.L: Y sucedió después de esto que David hirió a los filisteos y los sometió, y tomó Gat y sus aldeas de mano de los filisteos.
es.B: Algún tiempo después, David derrotó a los filisteos y los sometió a su dominio. Les quitó de las manos Gat y sus aldeas.
es.R: Más tarde David derrotó a los filisteos y los obligó a rendirse ante él. Les quitó a los filisteos Gat y las aldeas de alrededor.

fr.L: Et il arriva après cela que David frappa les Philistins et les abaissa, et il prit Gath et ses filles de la main des Philistins.
fr.B: Quelque temps après, David battit les Philistins et les soumit. Il enleva Gath et ses villages aux mains des Philistins.
fr.R: Plus tard, David a battu les Philistins et les a obligés à se soumettre. Il a pris aux Philistins la ville de Gath et les villages autour.

sw.L: Ikawa baada ya hayo, Daudi akawapiga Wafilisti akawatiisha, akatwaa Gathi na vijiji vyake kutoka mkononi mwa Wafilisti.
sw.B: Baada ya hayo, Daudi aliwashinda Wafilisti akawaweka chini ya mamlaka yake. Akautwaa Gathi na vijiji vyake kutoka mikononi mwa Wafilisti.
sw.R: Baadaye Daudi aliwashinda Wafilisti akawalazimisha wajisalimishe kwake. Akautwaa Gathi na vijiji vilivyouzunguka kutoka kwa Wafilisti.

vi.L: Sau việc này, Đa-vít đánh bại người Phi-li-tin và khuất phục họ; ông chiếm lấy Gát và các làng của nó khỏi tay người Phi-li-tin.
vi.B: Sau đó ít lâu, Đa-vít đánh bại người Phi-li-tin và bắt họ phải quy phục. Ông chiếm lấy Gát và các làng chung quanh khỏi tay người Phi-li-tin.
vi.R: Về sau, Đa-vít đánh bại người Phi-li-tin và bắt họ phải đầu hàng. Ông lấy Gát và các làng chung quanh khỏi tay người Phi-li-tin.

ko.L: 그리고 그 뒤에, 다윗이 블레셋 사람들을 쳐서 그들을 굴복시켰다. 그리고 그가 블레셋 사람들의 손에서 가드와 그 딸들을 빼앗았다.
ko.B: 얼마 뒤에 다윗은 블레셋 사람들을 쳐부수고 그들을 굴복시켰다. 그는 블레셋 사람들의 손에서 가드와 그 주변 마을들을 빼앗았다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 다윗은 블레셋 사람들을 쳐서 이기고 그들을 굴복시켰다. 그는 블레셋 사람들에게서 가드와 그 주변 마을들을 빼앗았다.

pt.L: E aconteceu depois disso que Davi feriu os filisteus e os subjugou, e tomou Gate e as suas filhas da mão dos filisteus.
pt.B: Algum tempo depois, Davi derrotou os filisteus e os submeteu ao seu domínio. Ele tirou Gate e os seus povoados do poder dos filisteus.
pt.R: Mais tarde Davi derrotou os filisteus e os obrigou a se render a ele. Ele tomou dos filisteus Gate e os povoados em volta dela.

am.L: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማውያንን መታ፤ አስገዛቸውም፤ ጌትንና መንደሮቿንም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ ወሰደ።
am.B: ከዚህ ጥቂት ጊዜ በኋላ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ድል አድርጎ በሥልጣኑ ሥር አስገባቸው። ጌትንና መንደሮቿንም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን እጅ ወሰደ።
am.R: ከጊዜ በኋላ ዳዊት ፍልስጥኤማውያንን ድል አደረገ፤ እንዲገዙለትም አደረጋቸው። ጌትንና በዙሪያዋ ያሉትን መንደሮች ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ወሰደ።

hi.L: और इसके बाद ऐसा हुआ कि दाऊद ने पलिश्तियों को मारा और उन्हें अधीन किया, और उसने गत और उसकी बेटियों को पलिश्तियों के हाथ से ले लिया।
hi.B: कुछ समय बाद दाऊद ने पलिश्तियों को हराया और उन्हें अपने वश में कर लिया। उसने गत और उसके गाँवों को पलिश्तियों के हाथ से छीन लिया।
hi.R: बाद में दाऊद ने पलिश्तियों को हराया और उन्हें अपने अधीन होने पर मजबूर किया। उसने गत और उसके आसपास के गाँवों को पलिश्तियों से छीन लिया।

ru.L: И было после этого: и поразил Давид филистимлян, и смирил их, и взял Геф и его селения из руки филистимлян.
ru.B: Некоторое время спустя Давид разбил филистимлян и подчинил их себе. Он отнял у филистимлян Геф и его селения.
ru.R: Позже Давид разбил филистимлян и заставил их покориться. Он забрал у филистимлян Геф и селения вокруг него.

uk.L: І сталося після цього, і вразив Давид филистимлян, і впокорив їх, і взяв Гат та його дочірні [міста] з руки филистимлян.
uk.B: Через якийсь час Давид розбив филистимлян і підкорив їх. Він забрав Гат і його села з рук филистимлян.
uk.R: Згодом Давид переміг филистимлян і змусив їх скоритися. Він відібрав у филистимлян Гат і села довкола нього.

decisions.choice: 1 Chronicles 18:1-17 retells 2 Samuel 8:1-18
decisions.reason: This chapter gives David's wars and his officials in nearly the same words as 2 Samuel 8, and each record notes where the words differ. As there, "after this" loosely joins the summary of David's wars to the LORD's promise in chapter 17, without dating every battle after it.

decisions.choice: Gath and its villages, where 2 Samuel 8:1 has Metheg-ammah
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:1 says David took "Metheg-ammah", a name whose meaning is not clear. Here David takes Gath, one of the five chief Philistine cities (1 Samuel 6:17), with the villages around it. The Chronicler names the place plainly. 2 Samuel 8:1 also repeats "David" as the subject of "took"; here the verb has no named subject.

decisions.choice: its daughters: the villages that depend on the town; from the hand: from their control
decisions.reason: A town's "daughters" are the smaller settlements around it (Numbers 21:25; Joshua 15:45). "Hand" stands for power, as in 2 Samuel 8:1.

decisions.choice: brought them under his control (Balanced); made them give in to him (Readable); villages
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:1. Literal keeps "daughters"; Balanced and Readable say "villages", as Numbers 21:25 does.

decisions.choice: sus aldeas (for "its daughters")
decisions.reason: Spanish "sus hijas" would not be understood of a town's villages, so even Literal says "sus aldeas"; the English Literal keeps "daughters".

decisions.choice: Gathi na vijiji vyake
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Gath and its daughters" where 2 Samuel 8:1 has "Metheg-ammah"; the Hebrew "daughters" of a town are its villages, which every level says, as the English Balanced and Readable do.

decisions.choice: "các làng của nó" (L); "các làng chung quanh" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew's "daughters" of a town are its villages; Vietnamese "con gái" would not be understood, so Literal too says "làng", as the Vietnamese Kings drafts do.

decisions.choice: "그 딸들" (L); "그 주변 마을들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "daughters" for a town's villages; Balanced and Readable say "villages". The chapter otherwise keeps the Korean of 2 Samuel 8, changing only what the Hebrew of Chronicles changes.

decisions.choice: as 2 Samuel 8:1; Gate e as suas filhas (L), os seus povoados (B), os povoados em volta dela (R)
decisions.reason: For 1 Chronicles 18:1-17, which retells 2 Samuel 8 (m1), the Portuguese of 2 Samuel 8 is kept level by level wherever the Hebrew is the same, and only what Chronicles changes is changed. Here Chronicles names "Gate" (the form of 1 Samuel, "Aquis, rei de Gate") with its villages instead of Metegue-Amá (m2): Literal keeps "as suas filhas" and Balanced "povoados", as Numbers 21:25 in Portuguese; Readable says where they were (m3).

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:1 copied, with "ጌትንና መንደሮቿን" (Gath and its villages) for Samuel's Metheg-ammah; "struck" is "መታ" (Literal), "ድል አደረገ" (Balanced, Readable), through the chapter as in Samuel
decisions.reason: The towns that depend on a city are "its daughters" in Hebrew; Numbers 32:42 gives them as "መንደሮቿ". Chronicles also leaves out the second "David".

decisions.choice: "गत और उसकी बेटियों" (Literal); "उसके गाँवों" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: This chapter retells 2 Samuel 8 and keeps its Hindi at each level where the Hebrew is the same. Here Chronicles names Gath and its towns where Samuel has Metheg-ammah, so the Hindi differs. Literal keeps "daughters" for the villages, as Numbers 21:25 does in this translation; Balanced and Readable say "गाँवों".

decisions.choice: the Russian of 2 Samuel 8:1, with "Геф и его селения" for Metheg-ammah
decisions.reason: Chapter 18 retells 2 Samuel 8 (m1) and keeps its wording at each level where the Hebrew is the same. Here Chronicles names Gath (m2); its "daughters" are the villages that belong to the town (m3), which Russian says plainly even at the Literal level, since "дочери" of a town would not be understood.

source.text: וַיַּ֖ךְ אֶת־מוֹאָ֑ב וַיִּהְי֤וּ מוֹאָב֙ עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֔יד נֹשְׂאֵ֖י מִנְחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he struck Moab, and became Moab servants to David bearing tribute.

en.L: And he struck Moab, and Moab became servants to David, bearing tribute.
en.B: He also defeated Moab, and the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.
en.R: David also defeated the Moabites. So they came under David's rule and paid him tribute.

es.L: E hirió a Moab, y Moab llegó a ser siervo de David, pagándole tributo.
es.B: También derrotó a Moab, y los moabitas quedaron sometidos a David y le pagaban tributo.
es.R: David también derrotó a los moabitas. Así quedaron bajo el dominio de David y le pagaban tributo.

fr.L: Et il frappa Moab, et Moab devint pour David des serviteurs portant tribut.
fr.B: Il battit aussi Moab, et les Moabites furent soumis à David et lui payèrent un tribut.
fr.R: David a aussi battu les Moabites. Ainsi ils sont passés sous l’autorité de David et lui ont payé un tribut.

sw.L: Akawapiga Moabu, nao Moabu wakawa watumishi wa Daudi, wakileta kodi.
sw.B: Aliwashinda pia Moabu, nao Wamoabu wakawa chini ya Daudi, wakamletea kodi.
sw.R: Daudi aliwashinda pia Wamoabu. Basi wakawa chini ya utawala wa Daudi, wakamlipa kodi.

vi.L: Ông đánh bại Mô-áp, và Mô-áp trở thành đầy tớ của Đa-vít, nộp cống.
vi.B: Ông cũng đánh bại Mô-áp, và người Mô-áp phải thần phục Đa-vít và nộp cống cho ông.
vi.R: Đa-vít cũng đánh bại người Mô-áp. Vì vậy họ phải chịu sự cai trị của Đa-vít và nộp cống cho ông.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 모압을 쳤다. 그리고 모압은 다윗에게 조공을 바치는 종이 되었다.
ko.B: 다윗은 모압도 쳐부수었다. 모압 사람들은 다윗에게 굴복하여 조공을 바쳤다.
ko.R: 다윗은 모압 사람들도 쳐서 이겼다. 그래서 모압 사람들은 다윗의 다스림을 받게 되었고 그에게 조공을 바쳤다.

pt.L: E feriu Moabe, e Moabe se tornou escravo de Davi, trazendo tributo.
pt.B: Ele também derrotou Moabe, e os moabitas ficaram sujeitos a Davi e lhe pagavam tributo.
pt.R: Davi também derrotou os moabitas. Assim eles ficaram sob o domínio de Davi e lhe pagavam tributo.

am.L: ሞዓብንም መታ፤ ሞዓብም ግብር የሚያመጡ የዳዊት ባሪያዎች ሆኑ።
am.B: ዳዊት ሞዓብንም ድል አደረገ። ሞዓባውያንም ለዳዊት ተገዙ፤ ግብርም አመጡለት።
am.R: ዳዊት ሞዓባውያንንም ድል አደረገ። ስለዚህ ሞዓባውያን በዳዊት አገዛዝ ሥር ሆኑ፤ ግብርም ይከፍሉት ነበር።

hi.L: और उसने मोआब को मारा, और मोआब दाऊद के दास हो गए, और कर देने लगे।
hi.B: उसने मोआब को भी हराया, और मोआबी दाऊद के अधीन हो गए और उसे कर देने लगे।
hi.R: दाऊद ने मोआबियों को भी हराया। इस प्रकार वे दाऊद के शासन के अधीन आ गए और उसे कर देने लगे।

ru.L: И поразил он Моава, и стал Моав Давиду рабами, приносящими дань.
ru.B: Он разбил и Моава, и моавитяне подчинились Давиду и стали платить ему дань.
ru.R: Давид разбил и моавитян. Так они стали подвластны Давиду и платили ему дань.

uk.L: І вразив він Моава, і стали моавітяни рабами Давидові, що приносили данину.
uk.B: Він також розбив Моава, і моавітяни підкорилися Давидові й приносили йому данину.
uk.R: Давид також переміг моавітян. Тож вони опинилися під владою Давида й платили йому данину.

decisions.choice: no measuring of the captives with a line
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:2 tells how David made the Moabite captives lie on the ground and measured them off with a cord, two lengths to be killed and one to live. Here only the victory and Moab's tribute are told.

decisions.choice: servants bearing tribute: a subject people paying regular tribute
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:2. "Servants" here means a nation under David's rule, and the tribute is the gift a subject king brings his overlord (Judges 3:15-18).

decisions.choice: became subject to David (Balanced); came under David's rule (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:2: for a whole nation "servants" means subjects; Literal keeps the word "servants".

decisions.choice: "조공을 바치는 종" (L), "굴복하여 조공을 바쳤다" (B), "다윗의 다스림을 받게 되었고" (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 8:2 in Korean: a subject people, not household slaves. Chronicles leaves out the measuring of the Moabite prisoners.

decisions.choice: as 2 Samuel 8:2, without the measuring of the captives
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:2 in Portuguese at each level ("escravo" at Literal, in the singular agreeing with "Moabe"; "sujeitos" at Balanced, "sob o domínio" at Readable; "tributo"), leaving out the measuring with the cord, which Chronicles does not tell (m1).

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:2 copied without the measuring of the captives; tribute (minchah) "ግብር", as there
decisions.reason: Chronicles has only the defeat and the tribute, in the same Hebrew words as Samuel.

decisions.choice: 2 Samuel 8:2 without the measuring line
decisions.reason: Chronicles leaves out the measuring of the captives (m1); the rest keeps the Samuel wording.

source.text: וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛יד אֶת־הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר מֶֽלֶךְ־צוֹבָ֖ה חֲמָ֑תָה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהַצִּ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר־פְּרָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And struck David Hadadezer king of Zobah toward Hamath, in his going to set up his hand at [the] river Euphrates.

en.L: And David struck Hadadezer king of Zobah toward Hamath, as he went to set up his hand at the river Euphrates.
en.B: David also defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, when Hadadezer went to set up his monument at the Euphrates River.
en.R: David also defeated Hadadezer, the king of Zobah, in the land toward Hamath. This happened when Hadadezer was going to set up a monument to his power by the Euphrates River.

es.L: E hirió David a Hadad-ezer rey de Soba, hacia Hamat, cuando iba a erigir su mano junto al río Éufrates.
es.B: David también derrotó a Hadad-ezer, rey de Soba, cerca de Hamat, cuando Hadad-ezer iba a erigir su monumento junto al río Éufrates.
es.R: David también derrotó a Hadad-ezer, el rey de Soba, en la región que da hacia Hamat. Esto ocurrió cuando Hadad-ezer iba a levantar un monumento a su poder junto al río Éufrates.

fr.L: Et David frappa Hadadézer, roi de Soba, vers Hamath, alors qu’il allait établir sa main sur le fleuve Euphrate.
fr.B: David battit aussi Hadadézer, roi de Soba, du côté de Hamath, alors qu’Hadadézer allait ériger son monument sur l’Euphrate.
fr.R: David a aussi battu Hadadézer, le roi de Soba, dans la région qui va vers Hamath. Cela s’est passé quand Hadadézer allait dresser un monument à sa gloire au bord de l’Euphrate.

sw.L: Daudi akampiga Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba kuelekea Hamathi, alipokwenda kusimamisha mkono wake kwenye mto Frati.
sw.B: Daudi alimshinda pia Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba, kuelekea Hamathi, Hadadezeri alipokwenda kusimamisha mnara wake wa ukumbusho kwenye mto Frati.
sw.R: Daudi alimshinda pia Hadadezeri, mfalme wa Soba, katika nchi inayoelekea Hamathi. Hii ilitokea Hadadezeri alipokuwa akienda kusimamisha mnara wa kuonyesha uwezo wake kando ya mto Frati.

vi.L: Đa-vít đánh bại Ha-đa-đê-xe vua Xô-ba về phía Ha-mát, khi vua ấy đi dựng tay mình tại sông Ơ-phơ-rát.
vi.B: Đa-vít cũng đánh bại Ha-đa-đê-xe vua Xô-ba, về phía Ha-mát, khi Ha-đa-đê-xe đi dựng bia kỷ niệm của mình tại sông Ơ-phơ-rát.
vi.R: Đa-vít cũng đánh bại Ha-đa-đê-xe, vua nước Xô-ba, tại vùng đất về phía Ha-mát. Việc này xảy ra khi Ha-đa-đê-xe đang đi dựng một bia kỷ niệm quyền lực của mình bên sông Ơ-phơ-rát.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 하맛 쪽에서 소바 왕 하닷에셀을 쳤는데, 그가 유프라테스 강에 자기 손을 세우려고 갈 때였다.

decisions.choice: differences from 2 Samuel 8:3
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:3 calls the king "Hadadezer son of Rehob" and says he went "to restore his hand". Here his father is not named, "toward Hamath" is added, and the verb is "to set up". The name is spelled Hadadezer in both books in the Hebrew text followed here; some older printed Hebrew editions, followed by the King James Version, spell it Hadarezer in Chronicles, with one similar letter changed.

decisions.choice: set up his hand: set up his monument, a sign of his rule
decisions.reason: The verb is used for setting up a standing stone or pillar, and Saul "set up a hand" for himself at Carmel, a victory monument (1 Samuel 15:12; compare 2 Samuel 18:18). So the sense here is most likely a monument claiming the land along the Euphrates. It could also mean, as in 2 Samuel 8:3, to set up his power there; either way he was asserting his rule along the river.

decisions.choice: toward Hamath: the part of Zobah that reached toward Hamath, where the battle was fought
decisions.reason: The ending on "Hamath" marks direction. It places the battle in the north of Zobah, toward the kingdom of Hamath (verse 9). It could also mean that David drove Hadadezer's army back as far as Hamath.

decisions.choice: he: Hadadezer, on his way to the Euphrates
alternatives: David, going to set up his own monument at the Euphrates
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:3: "he" is most likely Hadadezer, setting out to secure his power at the river. It could also mean David, going to set up his own power there (Genesis 15:18).

decisions.choice: when Hadadezer went; a monument to his power (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Hadadezer for "he", following m4. Readable says what the monument stood for.

decisions.choice: kusimamisha mkono wake (L); mnara wa ukumbusho (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "to set up his hand" where 2 Samuel 8:3 has "to restore his hand"; a "hand" set up is a monument, which Balanced and Readable name.

decisions.choice: "자기 손을 세우려고"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "set up his hand", a monument; Literal keeps "손", and Balanced and Readable say "기념비", as the English does.

decisions.choice: em direção a Hamate (L), perto de (B), na região que fica na direção de (R); erguer o seu monumento
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 8:3 in Portuguese, without "filho de Reobe" and with Chronicles' "toward Hamath" and its verb "set up" (m1, m3). Portuguese "erguer a sua mão" would read as raising a hand, so Literal says "monumento", what the "hand" was here (m2), as 2 Samuel 8:3 in Portuguese said "o seu poder" for its "hand". "Hamate" as 2 Samuel 8:9.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:3 kept for the shared words; Chronicles' "toward Hamath" ("በሐማት አቅጣጫ") and "to set up his hand" ("እጁን ሊያቆም", Balanced "የመታሰቢያ ሐውልቱን ለማቆም") followed, without "son of Rehob"
decisions.reason: Samuel has "to restore his hand", which its Amharic reads as regaining control; Chronicles' verb means to set up, which the meaning decision reads as a monument. Hamath "ሐማት" as 2 Samuel 8:9.

decisions.choice: "अपना हाथ खड़ा करने" (Literal); "अपना स्मारक खड़ा करने" (Balanced, Readable)
alternatives: "अपना हाथ फिर से स्थापित करने", as 2 Samuel 8:3
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "to set up his hand", where 2 Samuel 8:3 has "to restore his hand". Literal keeps the hand; Balanced and Readable say "स्मारक" (monument), the word 1 Samuel 15:12 uses for the same Hebrew in this translation.

decisions.choice: "утвердить свою руку" (Literal), "поставить памятник" (Balanced, Readable); "к Емафу"
decisions.reason: Where 2 Samuel 8:3 has "son of Rehob" and "to restore his hand", Chronicles has "toward Hamath" and "to set up his hand", a monument of his rule (m1, m2), so the Russian differs there.

records.literal_gloss: And captured David from him [a] thousand chariot[s] and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand man [on] foot; and hamstrung David all the chariotry, and left from it a hundred chariot[s].

en.L: And David captured from him 1,000 chariot[s] and 7,000 horsemen and 20,000 men on foot. And David hamstrung all the chariot [horses], and he left of them a hundred chariot[s].
en.B: David captured 1,000 chariots, 7,000 horsemen and 20,000 foot soldiers from him. He hamstrung all the chariot horses but kept enough of them for a hundred chariots.
en.R: David captured 1,000 chariots, 7,000 horsemen and 20,000 foot soldiers. He crippled all the chariot horses so that they could not be used in battle, except for enough to pull a hundred chariots.

es.L: Y le tomó David 1 000 carros y 7 000 jinetes y 20 000 hombres de a pie. Y David desjarretó a todos los [caballos de los] carros, y dejó de ellos para cien carros.
es.B: David le capturó 1 000 carros, 7 000 jinetes y 20 000 soldados de a pie. Desjarretó a todos los caballos de los carros, pero dejó los suficientes para cien carros.
es.R: David capturó 1 000 carros, 7 000 jinetes y 20 000 soldados de a pie. Les cortó los tendones a todos los caballos de los carros para que no pudieran usarse en la batalla, excepto los suficientes para tirar de cien carros.

fr.L: Et David lui prit 1 000 char[s], et 7 000 cavaliers, et 20 000 hommes à pied. Et David coupa les jarrets de tous les [chevaux de] chars, et il en laissa cent char[s].
fr.B: David lui prit 1 000 chars, 7 000 cavaliers et 20 000 fantassins. Il coupa les jarrets de tous les chevaux de char, mais il en garda assez pour cent chars.
fr.R: David a capturé 1 000 chars, 7 000 cavaliers et 20 000 soldats à pied. Il a coupé les jarrets de tous les chevaux de char pour qu’ils ne puissent plus servir à la guerre, sauf ce qu’il fallait pour tirer cent chars.

sw.L: Daudi akateka kwake magari 1,000 na wapanda farasi 7,000 na watu waendao kwa miguu 20,000. Daudi akawakata mishipa ya miguu [farasi] wote wa magari, akabakiza kati yao [wa] magari mia moja.
sw.B: Daudi aliteka kwake magari ya vita 1,000, wapanda farasi 7,000 na askari wa miguu 20,000. Akawakata mishipa ya miguu farasi wote wa magari ya vita, lakini akabakiza wa kutosha magari mia moja.
sw.R: Daudi aliteka magari ya vita 1,000, wapanda farasi 7,000 na askari wa miguu 20,000. Akawakata mishipa ya miguu farasi wote wa magari ya vita ili wasiweze kutumika vitani, isipokuwa farasi wa kutosha kuvuta magari mia moja.

vi.L: Đa-vít bắt của vua ấy 1.000 cỗ xe, 7.000 kỵ binh và 20.000 bộ binh. Đa-vít cắt gân hết thảy [ngựa] kéo xe, chỉ chừa lại [đủ ngựa cho] một trăm cỗ xe.
vi.B: Đa-vít bắt được của vua ấy 1.000 cỗ xe, 7.000 kỵ binh và 20.000 bộ binh. Ông cho cắt gân hết thảy ngựa kéo xe, chỉ để lại đủ ngựa cho một trăm cỗ xe.
vi.R: Đa-vít bắt được 1.000 cỗ xe, 7.000 kỵ binh và 20.000 bộ binh. Ông cho làm què tất cả ngựa kéo xe để chúng không thể ra trận được nữa, chỉ chừa lại đủ ngựa để kéo một trăm cỗ xe.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 그에게서 병거 1,000[대]와 기병 7,000명과 보병 20,000명을 사로잡았다. 그리고 다윗이 병거 [말들을] 모두 발의 힘줄을 끊고, 그 가운데 병거 100[대분]만 남겼다.

ko.R: 다윗은 병거 1,000대와 기병 7,000명과 보병 20,000명을 사로잡았다. 그는 병거를 끄는 말들의 다리 힘줄을 모두 끊어서 싸움에 쓸 수 없게 했다. 다만 병거 100대를 끌 수 있을 만큼의 말은 남겨 두었다.

am.L: ዳዊትም ከእርሱ 1,000 ሰረገሎችን፣ 7,000 ፈረሰኞችንና 20,000 እግረኞችን ማረከ፤ ዳዊትም የሰረገሎቹን [ፈረሶች] ሁሉ ቋንጃ ቆረጠ፤ ከእነርሱም ለመቶ ሰረገሎች [የሚበቁትን] አስቀረ።
am.B: ዳዊት ከእርሱ 1,000 ሰረገሎችን፣ 7,000 ፈረሰኞችንና 20,000 እግረኛ ወታደሮችን ማረከ። የሰረገላ ፈረሶቹንም ሁሉ ቋንጃቸውን ቆረጠ፤ ለመቶ ሰረገሎች የሚበቁትን ግን አስቀረ።
am.R: ዳዊት 1,000 ሰረገሎችን፣ 7,000 ፈረሰኞችንና 20,000 እግረኛ ወታደሮችን ማረከ። የሰረገላ ፈረሶቹ ሁሉ ለጦርነት እንዳይሆኑ ቋንጃቸውን ቆረጠ፤ መቶ ሰረገሎችን የሚጎትቱትን ብቻ አስቀረ።

hi.L: और दाऊद ने उससे 1,000 रथ और 7,000 घुड़सवार और 20,000 पैदल पुरुष पकड़ लिए। और दाऊद ने सब रथ [के घोड़ों] की नसें काट दीं, पर उनमें से सौ रथों के [लिए घोड़े] बचा रखे।
hi.B: दाऊद ने उससे 1,000 रथ, 7,000 घुड़सवार और 20,000 पैदल सैनिक पकड़ लिए। उसने रथों के सब घोड़ों की नसें काट दीं, पर सौ रथों के लिए घोड़े बचा रखे।
hi.R: दाऊद ने 1,000 रथ, 7,000 घुड़सवार और 20,000 पैदल सैनिक पकड़ लिए। उसने रथ के सब घोड़ों की टाँगों की नसें काटकर उन्हें लँगड़ा कर दिया, ताकि वे युद्ध में काम न आ सकें। केवल सौ रथ खींचने लायक़ घोड़े उसने बचा रखे।

ru.L: И захватил Давид у него тысячу колесниц, и семь тысяч всадников, и двадцать тысяч пеших. И подрезал Давид жилы всем колесничным [коням], и оставил из них на сто колесниц.
ru.B: Давид захватил у него тысячу колесниц и взял в плен семь тысяч всадников и двадцать тысяч пеших воинов. Он подрезал жилы всем колесничным коням, но оставил их столько, сколько нужно для ста колесниц.
ru.R: Давид захватил тысячу колесниц и взял в плен семь тысяч всадников и двадцать тысяч пеших воинов. Он искалечил всех коней, которые возили колесницы, чтобы на них нельзя было воевать. Он оставил только столько коней, сколько нужно было для ста колесниц.

uk.L: І захопив Давид у нього тисячу колісниць, і сім тисяч вершників, і двадцять тисяч піших людей. І підрізав Давид жили всім колісничним [коням], а залишив з них на сто колісниць.
uk.B: Давид захопив у нього тисячу колісниць, сім тисяч вершників і двадцять тисяч піших воїнів. Він підрізав жили всім колісничним коням, але залишив стільки, щоб вистачило на сто колісниць.
uk.R: Давид захопив тисячу колісниць, сім тисяч вершників і двадцять тисяч піших воїнів. Він покалічив усіх колісничних коней, щоб їх не можна було використати в бою, крім тих, яких вистачало, щоб тягти сто колісниць.

decisions.choice: 1,000 chariots and 7,000 horsemen, where 2 Samuel 8:4 has 1,700 horsemen
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:4 has "1,700 horsemen" and no chariots. The Greek translation of Samuel agrees with Chronicles, and the Hebrew of Samuel may have lost the word "chariots" in copying (see the note there). On the size of "thousand" in such counts, see the note at Numbers 1.

decisions.choice: hamstrung the chariot horses: cut the tendons of their hind legs so they could not run
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:4. Joshua did the same at the LORD's command (Joshua 11:6, 9), and Israel's kings were not to gather many horses (Deuteronomy 17:16).

decisions.choice: chariot [horses]; enough of them for a hundred chariots
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:4: Literal brackets "horses"; Balanced and Readable say it plainly, and Readable adds what hamstringing did.

decisions.choice: numbers in figures, as the English does here ("1,000", "100")
decisions.reason: As the large numbers of 2 Samuel 8:4 in Korean; Chronicles adds the 1,000 chariots and has 7,000 horsemen where Samuel has 1,700.

decisions.choice: mil carros e sete mil cavaleiros
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:4 in Portuguese ("jarretou" at Literal and Balanced, "aleijou" at Readable), with Chronicles' numbers (m1): "mil carros" added and "sete mil cavaleiros" for 2 Samuel's "mil e setecentos". All the numbers here are round, so they are written in words at every level.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:4 copied, with Chronicles' numbers: 1,000 chariots and 7,000 horsemen where Samuel has 1,700 horsemen
decisions.reason: The numbers follow the Hebrew of Chronicles (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: numbers in words: "тысячу колесниц", "семь тысяч всадников"
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:4 in Russian, the numbers are written in words; Chronicles has 1,000 chariots and 7,000 horsemen where Samuel has 1,700 horsemen (m1).

source.text: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק לַעְז֕וֹר לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים־וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Aram [of] Damascus to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, and struck David among Aram twenty and two thousand man.

en.L: And Aram of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, and David struck down among Aram 22,000 men.
en.B: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down 22,000 of the Arameans.
en.R: The Arameans from Damascus came to help Hadadezer, the king of Zobah. But David killed 22,000 of them.

es.L: Y vino Aram de Damasco a ayudar a Hadad-ezer rey de Soba, e hirió David de Aram a 22 000 hombres.
es.B: Cuando los arameos de Damasco vinieron a ayudar a Hadad-ezer rey de Soba, David abatió a 22 000 arameos.
es.R: Los arameos de Damasco vinieron a ayudar a Hadad-ezer, el rey de Soba. Pero David mató a 22 000 de ellos.

fr.L: Et Aram de Damas vint au secours d’Hadadézer, roi de Soba, et David abattit parmi Aram 22 000 hommes.
fr.B: Quand les Araméens de Damas vinrent au secours d’Hadadézer, roi de Soba, David abattit 22 000 Araméens.
fr.R: Les Araméens de Damas sont venus aider Hadadézer, le roi de Soba. Mais David en a tué 22 000.

sw.L: Aramu wa Dameski wakaja kumsaidia Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba, naye Daudi akawaua katika Aramu watu 22,000.
sw.B: Waaramu wa Dameski walipokuja kumsaidia Hadadezeri mfalme wa Soba, Daudi aliwaua Waaramu 22,000.
sw.R: Waaramu kutoka Dameski walikuja kumsaidia Hadadezeri, mfalme wa Soba. Lakini Daudi akawaua 22,000 kati yao.

vi.L: Người A-ram ở Đa-mách đến giúp Ha-đa-đê-xe vua Xô-ba, và Đa-vít đánh giết trong số người A-ram 22.000 người.
vi.B: Khi người A-ram ở Đa-mách đến giúp Ha-đa-đê-xe vua Xô-ba, Đa-vít đánh giết 22.000 người A-ram.
vi.R: Người A-ram từ Đa-mách đến giúp Ha-đa-đê-xe, vua Xô-ba. Nhưng Đa-vít giết 22.000 người của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 다메섹의 아람이 소바 왕 하닷에셀을 도우려고 왔고, 다윗이 아람 사람 가운데 22,000명을 쳤다.
ko.B: 다메섹의 아람 사람들이 소바 왕 하닷에셀을 도우러 오자, 다윗은 아람 사람 22,000명을 쳐 죽였다.
ko.R: 다메섹의 아람 사람들이 소바 왕 하닷에셀을 도우러 왔다. 그러나 다윗은 그들 가운데 22,000명을 죽였다.

pt.L: E Arã de Damasco veio ajudar Hadadezer, rei de Zobá, e Davi feriu entre os arameus vinte e dois mil homens.
pt.B: Quando os arameus de Damasco vieram ajudar Hadadezer, rei de Zobá, Davi matou vinte e dois mil deles.
pt.R: Os arameus de Damasco vieram ajudar Hadadezer, o rei de Zobá. Mas Davi matou vinte e dois mil deles.

am.L: የደማስቆ አራምም የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን ሊረዱ መጡ፤ ዳዊትም ከአራም 22,000 ሰዎችን መታ።
am.B: የደማስቆ አራማውያን የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን ሊረዱ በመጡ ጊዜ ዳዊት ከአራማውያን 22,000 ሰዎችን ገደለ።
am.R: ከደማስቆ የመጡ አራማውያን የሱባን ንጉሥ አድርአዛርን ሊረዱ መጡ። ዳዊት ግን ከእነርሱ 22,000 ሰዎችን ገደለ።

hi.L: और दमिश्क का अराम सोबा के राजा हददेज़ेर की सहायता करने आया, और दाऊद ने अराम में से 22,000 पुरुषों को मार डाला।
hi.B: जब दमिश्क के अरामी सोबा के राजा हददेज़ेर की सहायता करने आए, तब दाऊद ने 22,000 अरामियों को मार गिराया।
hi.R: दमिश्क के अरामी सोबा के राजा हददेज़ेर की सहायता करने आए। पर दाऊद ने उनमें से 22,000 को मार डाला।

ru.L: И пришли арамеи Дамаска на помощь Адраазару, царю Сувы, и поразил Давид из арамеев двадцать две тысячи человек.
ru.B: Когда арамеи из Дамаска пришли на помощь Адраазару, царю Сувы, Давид перебил двадцать две тысячи арамеев.
ru.R: Арамеи из Дамаска пришли помочь Адраазару, царю Сувы. Но Давид убил двадцать две тысячи из них.

uk.L: І прийшов Арам із Дамаску допомогти Гадад-Езерові, цареві Цови, і вбив Давид з Араму двадцять дві тисячі чоловік.
uk.B: Коли арамейці з Дамаску прийшли допомогти Гадад-Езерові, цареві Цови, Давид убив двадцять дві тисячі арамейців.
uk.R: Арамейці з Дамаску прийшли допомогти Гадад-Езерові, цареві Цови. Але Давид убив двадцять дві тисячі з них.

decisions.choice: the same as 2 Samuel 8:5, with a later spelling of Damascus
decisions.reason: The verse matches 2 Samuel 8:5. Only the spelling of Damascus differs: Chronicles uses a later form of the name with an extra letter, found in the later books. Aram of Damascus was the Aramean kingdom around that city, in what is now Syria.

decisions.choice: struck down: killed in battle
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:5: with a count of men the verb means that many fell.

decisions.choice: the Arameans
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:5: Balanced and Readable name the people rather than the land.

decisions.choice: as 2 Samuel 8:5
decisions.reason: The verse is 2 Samuel 8:5 (m1), so the Portuguese of 2 Samuel is kept at every level; the later spelling of Damascus makes no difference in Portuguese ("Damasco").

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:5 copied at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is the same but for the later spelling of Damascus, which Amharic does not show.

source.text: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם דָּוִיד֙ בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּרְמֶ֔שֶׂק וַיְהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְדָוִ֔יד עֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ לְדָוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And put David in Aram [of] Damascus, and became Aram to David servants bearing tribute; and saved Yahweh to David in all that he went.

en.L: And David put [garrisons] in Aram of Damascus, and Aram became servants to David, bearing tribute. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saved David wherever he went.
en.B: Then David stationed garrisons in Aram of Damascus. The Arameans became David's subjects and paid him tribute. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave David victory wherever he went.
en.R: Then David put groups of soldiers in the Aramean lands around Damascus. The Arameans came under David's rule and paid him tribute. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made David win wherever he went.

es.L: Y puso David [guarniciones] en Aram de Damasco, y Aram llegó a ser siervo de David, pagándole tributo. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} salvaba a David dondequiera que iba.
es.B: Luego David estableció guarniciones en Aram de Damasco. Los arameos quedaron sometidos a David y le pagaban tributo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le daba la victoria a David dondequiera que iba.
es.R: Luego David puso grupos de soldados en las tierras arameas alrededor de Damasco. Los arameos quedaron bajo el dominio de David y le pagaban tributo. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hacía que David ganara dondequiera que iba.

fr.L: Et David mit [des garnisons] dans Aram de Damas, et Aram devint pour David des serviteurs portant tribut. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sauva David partout où il alla.
fr.B: Puis David plaça des garnisons dans l’Aram de Damas. Les Araméens furent soumis à David et lui payèrent un tribut. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donna la victoire à David partout où il alla.
fr.R: Ensuite David a installé des groupes de soldats dans les régions araméennes autour de Damas. Les Araméens sont passés sous l’autorité de David et lui ont payé un tribut. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait gagner David partout où il allait.

sw.L: Daudi akaweka [vikosi vya askari] katika Aramu wa Dameski, nao Aramu wakawa watumishi wa Daudi, wakileta kodi. Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwokoa Daudi kila alikokwenda.
sw.B: Kisha Daudi akaweka vikosi vya askari katika Aramu wa Dameski. Waaramu wakawa chini ya Daudi, wakamletea kodi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Daudi ushindi kila alikokwenda.
sw.R: Kisha Daudi akaweka vikundi vya askari katika nchi za Waaramu kandokando ya Dameski. Waaramu wakawa chini ya utawala wa Daudi, wakamlipa kodi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimfanya Daudi ashinde kila alikokwenda.

vi.L: Đa-vít đặt [các đồn binh] tại A-ram ở Đa-mách, và A-ram trở thành đầy tớ của Đa-vít, nộp cống. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giải cứu Đa-vít bất cứ nơi nào ông đi.
vi.B: Rồi Đa-vít đặt các đồn binh tại A-ram ở Đa-mách. Người A-ram phải thần phục Đa-vít và nộp cống cho ông. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho Đa-vít chiến thắng bất cứ nơi nào ông đi.
vi.R: Rồi Đa-vít đặt các toán lính đóng tại vùng đất A-ram chung quanh Đa-mách. Người A-ram phải chịu sự cai trị của Đa-vít và nộp cống cho ông. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho Đa-vít thắng trận bất cứ nơi nào ông đi.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 다메섹의 아람에 [수비대를] 두었고, 아람은 다윗에게 조공을 바치는 종이 되었다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗이 가는 모든 곳에서 그를 구원하셨다.
ko.B: 그리고 다윗은 다메섹의 아람에 수비대를 두었다. 아람 사람들은 다윗에게 굴복하여 조공을 바쳤다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 다윗이 가는 곳마다 그에게 승리를 주셨다.
ko.R: 그리고 다윗은 다메섹 주변의 아람 땅에 군대를 두어 지키게 했다. 아람 사람들은 다윗의 다스림을 받게 되었고 그에게 조공을 바쳤다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 다윗이 가는 곳마다 그를 이기게 해 주셨다.

pt.L: E Davi pôs [guarnições] em Arã de Damasco, e Arã se tornou escravo de Davi, trazendo tributo. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} salvava Davi por onde quer que ele fosse.
pt.B: Depois Davi colocou guarnições em Arã de Damasco. Os arameus ficaram sujeitos a Davi e lhe pagavam tributo. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dava vitória a Davi por onde quer que ele fosse.
pt.R: Depois Davi colocou grupos de soldados nas terras dos arameus, em volta de Damasco. Os arameus ficaram sob o domínio de Davi e lhe pagavam tributo. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fazia Davi vencer por onde quer que ele fosse.

am.L: ዳዊትም በደማስቆ አራም [የጦር ሰፈሮችን] አኖረ፤ አራምም ግብር የሚያመጡ የዳዊት ባሪያዎች ሆኑ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ዳዊትን በሄደበት ሁሉ አዳነው።
am.B: ከዚያም ዳዊት በደማስቆ አራም የጦር ሰፈሮችን አቆመ። አራማውያንም ለዳዊት ተገዙ፤ ግብርም አመጡለት። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዳዊትን በሄደበት ሁሉ ድል አቀዳጀው።
am.R: ከዚያም ዳዊት በደማስቆ ዙሪያ ባሉት በአራማውያን ምድር የወታደሮች ጭፍሮችን አኖረ። አራማውያን በዳዊት አገዛዝ ሥር ሆኑ፤ ግብርም ይከፍሉት ነበር። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዳዊትን በሄደበት ሁሉ አሸናፊ አደረገው።

hi.L: और दाऊद ने दमिश्क के अराम में [चौकियाँ] बैठाईं, और अराम दाऊद के दास हो गए, और कर देने लगे। और जहाँ-जहाँ वह गया, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दाऊद को बचाया।
hi.B: फिर दाऊद ने दमिश्क के अराम में चौकियाँ बैठाईं। अरामी दाऊद के अधीन हो गए और उसे कर देने लगे। दाऊद जहाँ कहीं गया, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे विजय दी।
hi.R: फिर दाऊद ने दमिश्क के आसपास के अरामी इलाक़ों में सैनिकों की टुकड़ियाँ बैठा दीं। अरामी दाऊद के शासन के अधीन आ गए और उसे कर देने लगे। दाऊद जहाँ भी गया, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे जिताया।

ru.L: И поставил Давид [гарнизоны] в Араме Дамасском, и стали арамеи Давиду рабами, приносящими дань. И спасал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Давида везде, куда он ни ходил.
ru.B: Затем Давид разместил гарнизоны в Араме Дамасском. Арамеи подчинились Давиду и стали платить ему дань. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} давал Давиду победу везде, куда бы он ни пошёл.
ru.R: Потом Давид поставил отряды воинов в арамейских землях вокруг Дамаска. Арамеи стали подвластны Давиду и платили ему дань. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} давал Давиду победу везде, куда бы он ни пошёл.

uk.L: І поставив Давид [залоги] в Арамі Дамаському, і став Арам рабами Давидові, що приносили данину. І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} рятував Давида скрізь, куди він ходив.
uk.B: Потім Давид поставив залоги в Арамі Дамаському. Арамейці підкорилися Давидові й платили йому данину. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} давав Давидові перемогу скрізь, куди він ходив.
uk.R: Потім Давид поставив загони воїнів в арамейських землях довкола Дамаску. Арамейці опинилися під владою Давида й платили йому данину. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} давав Давидові перемагати скрізь, куди він ходив.

decisions.choice: David put [garrisons] in Aram: the word "garrisons" is understood
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:6 reads "David put garrisons in Aram of Damascus". Here the Hebrew has only "David put in Aram". The word may have dropped out in copying, or the writer left it to be understood from the parallel and from verse 13; the Greek translation of Chronicles has it. Either way the sense is the same as in Samuel.

decisions.choice: servants bearing tribute: as in verse 2
decisions.reason: As with Moab in verse 2, Aram becomes a subject people paying tribute.

decisions.choice: the LORD saved David: the victories are the LORD's doing
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:6, the writer credits the LORD with all of David's success, as he had promised (17:8, "I have cut off all your enemies"). The same sentence closes verse 13.

decisions.choice: [garrisons] (Literal); garrisons (Balanced); groups of soldiers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Following m1, Literal brackets the word the Hebrew leaves out; Balanced and Readable supply it, as 2 Samuel 8:6 has it.

decisions.choice: gave David victory (Balanced); made David win (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:6: Literal keeps "saved"; in a battle the sense is victory.

decisions.choice: [guarnições]
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:6 in Portuguese at every level; Literal brackets "guarnições", the word Chronicles leaves to be understood (m1). "Salvava" (L), "dava vitória" (B) and "fazia vencer" (R) as there, and again in verse 13.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:6 copied, with "[የጦር ሰፈሮችን]" bracketed at Literal
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "David put in Aram" without the word "garrisons", which Samuel has (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "[гарнизоны]" in brackets
decisions.reason: The word is understood in the Chronicles Hebrew (m1), which 2 Samuel 8:6 writes out; the Literal brackets it.

records.literal_gloss: And took David the shields of the gold which were on [the] servants of Hadadezer, and brought them [to] Jerusalem.

en.L: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them [to] Jerusalem.
en.B: David took the gold shields that Hadadezer's officials had carried, and brought them to Jerusalem.
en.R: Hadadezer's officers had carried shields made of gold. David took them and brought them to Jerusalem.

es.L: Y tomó David los escudos de oro que tenían los siervos de Hadad-ezer, y los llevó [a] Jerusalén.
es.B: David tomó los escudos de oro que llevaban los oficiales de Hadad-ezer y los llevó a Jerusalén.
es.R: Los oficiales de Hadad-ezer habían llevado escudos de oro. David se los quitó y los llevó a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et David prit les boucliers d’or qui étaient sur les serviteurs d’Hadadézer, et les apporta [à] Jérusalem.
fr.B: David prit les boucliers d’or que portaient les officiers d’Hadadézer et les apporta à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Les officiers d’Hadadézer portaient des boucliers en or. David les a pris et il les a apportés à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Daudi akachukua ngao za dhahabu zilizokuwa juu ya watumishi wa Hadadezeri, akazileta [mpaka] Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Daudi alichukua ngao za dhahabu walizokuwa wamebeba maafisa wa Hadadezeri, akazileta Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Maafisa wa jeshi wa Hadadezeri walikuwa wamebeba ngao zilizotengenezwa kwa dhahabu. Daudi akazichukua akazileta Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Đa-vít lấy những cái khiên bằng vàng mà các đầy tớ của Ha-đa-đê-xe mang, và đem về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Đa-vít lấy những cái khiên bằng vàng mà các quan chức của Ha-đa-đê-xe mang, và đem về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Các sĩ quan của Ha-đa-đê-xe mang những cái khiên bằng vàng. Đa-vít lấy các khiên ấy và đem về Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 하닷에셀의 신하들이 지니고 있던 금 방패들을 빼앗아 예루살렘으로 가져왔다.
ko.B: 다윗은 하닷에셀의 신하들이 지니고 있던 금 방패들을 빼앗아 예루살렘으로 가져왔다.
ko.R: 하닷에셀의 장교들은 금으로 만든 방패를 가지고 있었다. 다윗은 그것들을 빼앗아 예루살렘으로 가져왔다.

pt.L: E Davi tomou os escudos de ouro que estavam com os servos de Hadadezer e os trouxe [a] Jerusalém.
pt.B: Davi tomou os escudos de ouro que os oficiais de Hadadezer carregavam e os levou para Jerusalém.
pt.R: Os oficiais de Hadadezer carregavam escudos feitos de ouro. Davi tomou esses escudos e os levou para Jerusalém.

am.L: ዳዊትም በአድርአዛር ባሪያዎች ላይ የነበሩትን የወርቅ ጋሻዎች ወሰደ፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም አመጣቸው።

records.literal_gloss: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, took David bronze much very; with it made Solomon the sea of the bronze and the pillars and the articles of the bronze.

en.L: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze. With it Solomon made the bronze Sea and the pillars and the articles of bronze.
en.B: From Tibhath and Cun, towns of Hadadezer, David took a great quantity of bronze. With it Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars and the bronze articles.
en.R: David also took a large amount of bronze from Tibhath and Cun, two of Hadadezer's towns. Later Solomon used this bronze to make the huge bronze basin called the Sea, the pillars and the bronze objects for the temple.

es.L: Y de Tibhat y de Cun, ciudades de Hadad-ezer, tomó David muchísimo bronce; con él hizo Salomón el Mar de bronce y las columnas y los utensilios de bronce.
es.B: De Tibhat y Cun, ciudades de Hadad-ezer, David tomó una gran cantidad de bronce. Con él Salomón hizo el Mar de bronce, las columnas y los utensilios de bronce.
es.R: David también se llevó mucho bronce de Tibhat y Cun, dos ciudades de Hadad-ezer. Más tarde Salomón usó ese bronce para hacer el enorme depósito de bronce llamado el Mar, las columnas y los objetos de bronce para el templo.

fr.L: Et de Tibhath et de Koun, villes d’Hadadézer, David prit du bronze en très grande quantité. Avec lui, Salomon fit la Mer de bronze, et les colonnes, et les objets de bronze.
fr.B: À Tibhath et à Koun, villes d’Hadadézer, David prit une grande quantité de bronze. Avec ce bronze, Salomon fit la Mer de bronze, les colonnes et les objets de bronze.
fr.R: David a aussi pris beaucoup de bronze à Tibhath et à Koun, deux villes d’Hadadézer. Plus tard, Salomon s’est servi de ce bronze pour faire l’immense bassin de bronze qu’on appelait la Mer, les colonnes et les objets de bronze du temple.

sw.L: Na kutoka Tibhathi na kutoka Kuni, miji ya Hadadezeri, Daudi akachukua shaba nyingi sana. Kwa hiyo Sulemani akaifanya Bahari ya shaba na nguzo na vyombo vya shaba.
sw.B: Kutoka Tibhathi na Kuni, miji ya Hadadezeri, Daudi alichukua shaba nyingi sana. Kwa shaba hiyo Sulemani aliifanya Bahari ya shaba, nguzo na vyombo vya shaba.
sw.R: Daudi alichukua pia shaba nyingi kutoka Tibhathi na Kuni, miji miwili ya Hadadezeri. Baadaye Sulemani alitumia shaba hiyo kufanya birika kubwa sana la shaba lililoitwa Bahari, nguzo na vyombo vya shaba kwa ajili ya hekalu.

vi.B: Từ Típ-hát và Cun, các thành của Ha-đa-đê-xe, Đa-vít lấy được một số lượng đồng rất lớn. Sa-lô-môn dùng đồng ấy làm cái Biển bằng đồng, các trụ và các vật dụng bằng đồng.

pt.L: E de Tibate e de Cum, cidades de Hadadezer, Davi tomou muitíssimo bronze. Com ele Salomão fez o Mar de bronze, e as colunas, e os utensílios de bronze.
pt.B: De Tibate e de Cum, cidades de Hadadezer, Davi tomou uma grande quantidade de bronze. Com ele Salomão fez o Mar de bronze, as colunas e os utensílios de bronze.

am.L: ከአድርአዛርም ከተሞች ከጥብሐትና ከኩን ዳዊት እጅግ ብዙ ነሐስ ወሰደ፤ ሰሎሞንም በእርሱ የነሐሱን ኩሬ፣ ምሰሶዎቹንና የነሐሱን ዕቃዎች ሠራ።
am.B: ዳዊት ከአድርአዛር ከተሞች ከጥብሐትና ከኩን እጅግ ብዙ ነሐስ ወሰደ። ሰሎሞንም በዚህ ነሐስ የነሐስ ኩሬውን፣ ምሰሶዎቹንና የነሐስ ዕቃዎቹን ሠራ።

hi.L: और हददेज़ेर के नगरों, तिभत से और कून से, दाऊद बहुत ही अधिक पीतल ले आया। उससे सुलैमान ने पीतल का समुद्र और खंभे और पीतल के पात्र बनाए।
hi.B: हददेज़ेर के नगरों, तिभत और कून से, दाऊद बहुत सा पीतल ले आया। उससे सुलैमान ने पीतल का समुद्र, खंभे और पीतल के पात्र बनाए।
hi.R: दाऊद हददेज़ेर के दो नगरों, तिभत और कून से, बहुत सा पीतल भी ले आया। बाद में सुलैमान ने इसी पीतल से वह विशाल हौज़ बनाया जिसे समुद्र कहा जाता था, और मंदिर के लिए खंभे और पीतल की वस्तुएँ भी बनाईं।

ru.L: И из Тивхата и из Куна, городов Адраазара, взял Давид очень много меди; из неё сделал Соломон медное море, и колонны, и медные вещи.
ru.B: Из Тивхата и Куна, городов Адраазара, Давид взял великое множество меди. Из неё Соломон сделал медное Море, колонны и медные вещи.
ru.R: Ещё Давид взял очень много меди из Тивхата и Куна, двух городов Адраазара. Позже Соломон сделал из этой меди огромный водоём, который называли Морем, колонны и медные вещи для храма.

uk.L: А з Тівхату та з Куну, міст Гадад-Езера, Давид узяв дуже багато міді. З неї Соломон зробив мідне море, і стовпи, і мідний посуд.
uk.B: З Тівхату та Куну, міст Гадад-Езера, Давид забрав дуже багато міді. З неї Соломон зробив мідне Море, стовпи й мідний посуд.
uk.R: Давид також забрав багато міді з Тівхату та Куну, двох міст Гадад-Езера. Пізніше Соломон зробив із цієї міді величезну мідну чашу, яку називали Морем, стовпи й мідні речі для храму.

decisions.choice: Tibhath and Cun, where 2 Samuel 8:8 has Betah and Berothai
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:8 names the towns Betah and Berothai and calls the taker "King David". Betah and Tibhath may be one name written differently; Cun is otherwise unknown, and may be another name for Berothai or a different town of the same region.

decisions.choice: with it Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars and the bronze articles
decisions.reason: This sentence is not in 2 Samuel 8:8. It looks ahead to the temple: the bronze taken in David's wars became the great basin called the Sea, the two pillars and the bronze vessels (1 Kings 7:15-47; 2 Chronicles 4:2-18). Chronicles stresses that David prepared materials for the house his son would build (22:3, 14).

decisions.choice: the bronze Sea: a huge basin in the temple court
decisions.reason: The Sea was a great round bronze basin standing on twelve bronze oxen, in which the priests washed (2 Chronicles 4:2-6).

decisions.choice: Later; the huge bronze basin called the Sea; for the temple
decisions.reason: Readable says that Solomon's work came later and explains what the Sea was and where the bronze was used.

decisions.choice: el Mar de bronce
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the Spanish of 1 Kings 7; Readable explains it as a great bronze basin.

decisions.choice: "la Mer de bronze"
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note, for the whole block.

decisions.choice: Bahari ya shaba (L, B); birika kubwa sana la shaba lililoitwa Bahari (R)
decisions.reason: The bronze basin keeps the name the terms note sets, "Bahari ya shaba", with a capital; Readable explains it as a huge basin, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "cái Biển bằng đồng"
decisions.reason: The Kings terms note's name for the bronze Sea of the temple; Readable explains it as a large basin.

decisions.choice: "놋 바다" (L, B); "바다라고 불리는 커다란 놋 물통" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's name for the bronze Sea; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Tibate; Cum; Davi (not "o rei Davi"); o Mar de bronze
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:8 in Portuguese with Chronicles' town names (m1), "Tibate" and "Cum" in their usual Brazilian forms, and "Davi" where Samuel has "o rei Davi". The added sentence (m2) names the basin as 1 Kings 7:23 in Portuguese does, "o Mar" with a capital, and Readable explains it with that chapter's "enorme tanque" (m3).

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:8 kept for "ከአድርአዛር ከተሞች … እጅግ ብዙ ነሐስ ወሰደ"; Tibhath "ጥብሐት" and Cun "ኩን" (new names) for Betah and Berothai; the bronze Sea "የነሐስ ኩሬ", as Kings
decisions.reason: Chronicles names other towns, says "David" without "King", and adds that Solomon made the Sea, the pillars and the bronze articles with this bronze.

decisions.choice: "तिभत", "कून"; "पीतल का समुद्र"; Readable "वह विशाल हौज़ ... जिसे समुद्र कहा जाता था"
decisions.reason: Chronicles names other towns than 2 Samuel 8:8; they are transcribed from the Hebrew. The Sea and the pillars are worded as in 1 Kings 7:15, 23 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "Тивхат", "Кун"; "Море" as in 1 Kings 7
decisions.reason: The towns have other names than in 2 Samuel 8:8 (m1), in their traditional Russian forms; the bronze Sea keeps the words of 1 Kings 7:23 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "мідь" / "мідний" for bronze
decisions.reason: The word used for the tabernacle bronze in Exodus and Numbers; kept here for the Sea, the pillars and the temple articles.

decisions.choice: Tou, where 2 Samuel 8:9 has Toi; "king of Zobah" added
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:9 spells the king's name Toi; the two spellings differ by one letter and name the same man. Here Hadadezer is also called "king of Zobah", as in verses 3 and 5.

decisions.choice: Tou king of Hamath: ruler of a kingdom north of Zobah
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:9. Hamath lay on the Orontes River and later marked the northern edge of Israel's land (Numbers 34:8; 1 Kings 8:65).

decisions.choice: one sentence running into verse 10
decisions.reason: Verse 9 says what Tou heard and verse 10 what he did about it.

decisions.choice: Tou; Hadoramu (verse 10)
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the king of Hamath "Tou" and his son "Hadoram", where 2 Samuel 8:9-10 has Toi and Joram; the Swahili keeps each book's spelling, as the English does.

decisions.choice: verse 9 closed as its own sentence; verse 10 begins with "그래서"
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 8:9-10 in Korean: Korean's verb-final order would carry the clause into verse 10. The king is "도우" (Tou), as Chronicles spells him, where Samuel has "도이".

decisions.choice: Toú
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the king's name differently from 2 Samuel 8:9's "Toí" (m1), so Portuguese writes "Toú", its accent marking the two syllables; the rest is 2 Samuel 8:9 in Portuguese, with "rei de Zobá" added.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:9 copied, adding "የሱባን ንጉሥ" (king of Zobah); Tou keeps "ቶዑ"
decisions.reason: Samuel's Toi is already "ቶዑ" in its Amharic, which matches Chronicles' spelling Tou; one form for the king in both books.

decisions.choice: "तोऊ" (Tou); "हदोराम" (Hadoram, verse 10)
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the king and his son differently from 2 Samuel 8 (Toi, Joram); the Hindi follows each book's Hebrew, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Фоу"
decisions.reason: Chronicles spells the name Tou where 2 Samuel 8:9 has Toi (m1); the Russian keeps the two forms apart, as the Hebrew and the English do.

records.literal_gloss: and sent Hadoram his son to the king David to ask to him for peace and to bless him because that he fought against Hadadezer and struck him, for [a] man of wars [of] Tou was Hadadezer; and all articles of gold and silver and bronze.

en.L: and he sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask him about [his] peace and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him, for Hadadezer had been a man of wars [with] Tou; and all [kinds of] articles of gold and silver and bronze.
en.B: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on fighting against Hadadezer and defeating him, for Hadadezer and Tou had often been at war. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold, silver and bronze.
en.R: So he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and to congratulate him for fighting Hadadezer and defeating him. Hadadezer had been at war with Tou many times. Hadoram brought all kinds of gifts made of gold, silver and bronze.

es.L: y envió a Hadoram su hijo al rey David para preguntarle por [su] paz y para bendecirlo, porque había peleado contra Hadad-ezer y lo había herido, pues Hadad-ezer era hombre de guerras [con] Tou; y toda [clase de] objetos de oro y de plata y de bronce.
es.B: envió a su hijo Hadoram al rey David para saludarlo y felicitarlo por haber luchado contra Hadad-ezer y haberlo derrotado, pues Hadad-ezer y Tou habían estado en guerra muchas veces. Hadoram llevó toda clase de objetos de oro, de plata y de bronce.
es.R: Así que envió a su hijo Hadoram a ver al rey David para saludarlo y felicitarlo por haber luchado contra Hadad-ezer y haberlo derrotado. Hadad-ezer había estado en guerra con Tou muchas veces. Hadoram llevó toda clase de regalos hechos de oro, plata y bronce.

fr.L: et il envoya Hadoram son fils au roi David pour lui demander [comment il allait] et pour le bénir, parce qu’il avait combattu contre Hadadézer et l’avait frappé, car Hadadézer était un homme en guerre [avec] Tou ; et toutes [sortes d’]objets d’or, et d’argent, et de bronze.
fr.B: il envoya son fils Hadoram au roi David pour le saluer et le féliciter d’avoir combattu Hadadézer et de l’avoir battu, car Hadadézer et Tou étaient souvent en guerre. Hadoram apporta toutes sortes d’objets d’or, d’argent et de bronze.
fr.R: Alors il a envoyé son fils Hadoram auprès du roi David pour le saluer et le féliciter d’avoir combattu et battu Hadadézer. Hadadézer avait souvent fait la guerre contre Tou. Hadoram a apporté toutes sortes de cadeaux en or, en argent et en bronze.

sw.L: akamtuma Hadoramu mwanawe kwa mfalme Daudi kumwuliza habari za amani [yake] na kumbariki, kwa sababu alikuwa amepigana na Hadadezeri na kumpiga, kwa maana Hadadezeri alikuwa mtu wa vita [na] Tou; na [kila aina ya] vyombo vya dhahabu na fedha na shaba.
sw.B: alimtuma mwanawe Hadoramu kwa mfalme Daudi kumsalimu na kumpongeza kwa kupigana na Hadadezeri na kumshinda, kwa maana Hadadezeri na Tou walikuwa wamepigana vita mara nyingi. Hadoramu alileta kila aina ya vyombo vya dhahabu, fedha na shaba.
sw.R: Basi akamtuma mwanawe Hadoramu kwa mfalme Daudi kumsalimu na kumpongeza kwa kupigana na Hadadezeri na kumshinda. Hadadezeri alikuwa amepigana na Tou mara nyingi. Hadoramu alileta kila aina ya zawadi zilizotengenezwa kwa dhahabu, fedha na shaba.

vi.L: thì ông sai Ha-đô-ram con trai mình đến cùng vua Đa-vít để hỏi thăm [sự] bình an của vua và chúc mừng vua, vì vua đã giao chiến với Ha-đa-đê-xe và đánh bại người, vì Ha-đa-đê-xe từng là người gây chiến với Thô-u; cùng mọi [thứ] vật dụng bằng vàng, bạc và đồng.
vi.B: thì ông sai con trai mình là Ha-đô-ram đến chào vua Đa-vít và chúc mừng vua đã giao chiến với Ha-đa-đê-xe và đánh bại người, vì Ha-đa-đê-xe với Thô-u vẫn thường đánh nhau. Ha-đô-ram mang theo đủ thứ vật dụng bằng vàng, bạc và đồng.
vi.R: Vì vậy ông sai con trai mình là Ha-đô-ram đến chào vua Đa-vít và chúc mừng vua đã đánh thắng Ha-đa-đê-xe. Ha-đa-đê-xe đã nhiều lần gây chiến với Thô-u. Ha-đô-ram mang theo đủ thứ quà làm bằng vàng, bạc và đồng.

ko.L: 그래서 그가 자기 아들 하도람을 다윗 왕에게 보내어 그에게 평안을 묻고 그를 축복하게 했다. 그가 하닷에셀과 싸워 그를 쳤기 때문이다. 하닷에셀은 도우와 전쟁을 하던 자였다. 그리고 금과 은과 놋으로 [만든] 온갖 그릇이 [있었다].
ko.B: 그래서 도우는 자기 아들 하도람을 다윗 왕에게 보내어 문안하고, 그가 하닷에셀과 싸워 이긴 것을 축하하게 했다. 하닷에셀은 도우와 자주 전쟁을 하던 사람이었다. 하도람은 금과 은과 놋으로 만든 온갖 물건을 가지고 왔다.
ko.R: 그래서 도우는 자기 아들 하도람을 다윗 왕에게 보내 인사하고, 하닷에셀과 싸워 이긴 것을 축하하게 했다. 하닷에셀은 여러 번 도우와 전쟁을 했었다. 하도람은 금과 은과 놋으로 만든 온갖 선물을 가지고 왔다.

pt.L: e enviou Hadorão, o seu filho, ao rei Davi para lhe perguntar pela [sua] paz e para abençoá-lo, porque tinha lutado contra Hadadezer e o tinha ferido, pois Hadadezer era homem de guerras [com] Toú; e todos [os tipos de] objetos de ouro, e de prata, e de bronze.
pt.B: enviou o seu filho Hadorão ao rei Davi para saudá-lo e felicitá-lo por ter lutado contra Hadadezer e o ter derrotado, pois Hadadezer e Toú estavam sempre em guerra. Hadorão levou consigo todo tipo de objetos de ouro, de prata e de bronze.
pt.R: Por isso mandou o seu filho Hadorão ao rei Davi para cumprimentá-lo e lhe dar os parabéns por ter lutado contra Hadadezer e o ter derrotado. Hadadezer tinha estado em guerra com Toú muitas vezes. Hadorão levou todo tipo de presentes feitos de ouro, de prata e de bronze.

am.L: ቶዑም ደኅንነቱን ይጠይቀው ዘንድና ይባርከው ዘንድ ልጁን ሀዶራምን ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ዳዊት ላከ፤ ከአድርአዛር ጋር ተዋግቶ መቶታልና፤ አድርአዛር የቶዑ የጦርነት ሰው ነበረና፤ የወርቅና የብር የነሐስም ዕቃዎች ሁሉ [ነበሩ]።

am.R: ስለዚህ ቶዑ ልጁን ሀዶራምን ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ዳዊት ላከው፤ ሰላምታ እንዲያቀርብለትና አድርአዛርን ወግቶ ስላሸነፈው ደስታውን እንዲገልጽለት ነበር። አድርአዛር ከቶዑ ጋር ብዙ ጊዜ ተዋግቶ ነበር። ሀዶራምም ከወርቅ፣ ከብርና ከነሐስ የተሠሩ ልዩ ልዩ ስጦታዎችን ይዞ መጣ።

hi.L: तो उसने अपने पुत्र हदोराम को राजा दाऊद के पास भेजा, कि उससे [उसका] कुशल पूछे और उसे आशीष दे, क्योंकि उसने हददेज़ेर से लड़कर उसे मारा था, क्योंकि हददेज़ेर तोऊ से युद्ध करनेवाला पुरुष था; और सोने और चाँदी और पीतल की सब [प्रकार की] वस्तुएँ।
hi.B: तो उसने अपने पुत्र हदोराम को राजा दाऊद के पास भेजा, कि वह उसका कुशल-क्षेम पूछे और उसे बधाई दे कि उसने हददेज़ेर से लड़कर उसे हरा दिया है, क्योंकि हददेज़ेर और तोऊ में अक्सर युद्ध होता रहता था। हदोराम अपने साथ सोने, चाँदी और पीतल की सब प्रकार की वस्तुएँ लाया।
hi.R: इसलिए उसने अपने पुत्र हदोराम को राजा दाऊद के पास भेजा, ताकि वह उसका हाल-चाल पूछे और उसे बधाई दे कि उसने हददेज़ेर से लड़कर उसे हरा दिया है। हददेज़ेर कई बार तोऊ से युद्ध कर चुका था। हदोराम सोने, चाँदी और पीतल की बनी सब प्रकार की भेंटें लेकर आया।

ru.L: и послал Гадорама, своего сына, к царю Давиду, чтобы спросить его о мире и благословить его за то, что он воевал с Адраазаром и поразил его, ведь Адраазар был человеком войн с Фоу; и всякие вещи золотые, и серебряные, и медные.
ru.B: он послал своего сына Гадорама к царю Давиду приветствовать его и поздравить с тем, что он воевал с Адраазаром и разбил его, ведь Адраазар и Фоу часто воевали друг с другом. Гадорам принёс всевозможные золотые, серебряные и медные вещи.
ru.R: Поэтому он послал своего сына Гадорама к царю Давиду, чтобы приветствовать его и поздравить с победой над Адраазаром. Адраазар много раз воевал с Фоу. Гадорам принёс разные подарки из золота, серебра и меди.

uk.L: і послав він Гадорама, свого сина, до царя Давида, щоб запитати його про мир і благословити його за те, що той воював з Гадад-Езером і розбив його, бо Гадад-Езер був чоловіком воєн [проти] Тоу; і всілякий посуд із золота, і срібла, і міді.
uk.B: він послав свого сина Гадорама до царя Давида, щоб привітати його й поздоровити з тим, що він воював з Гадад-Езером і розбив його, бо Гадад-Езер і Тоу часто воювали між собою. Гадорам приніс усілякі речі із золота, срібла й міді.
uk.R: Тож він послав свого сина Гадорама до царя Давида, щоб привітати його й поздоровити з тим, що він воював з Гадад-Езером і переміг його. Гадад-Езер багато разів воював з Тоу. Гадорам приніс усілякі дари із золота, срібла й міді.

decisions.choice: Hadoram, where 2 Samuel 8:10 has Joram; the gifts listed without a verb
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:10 calls the son Joram, a name containing a short form of the LORD's name; Hadoram contains the name of the Aramean god Hadad (see the note there). 2 Samuel also says the articles were "in his hand" and lists silver first; here the verse ends simply "and all articles of gold and silver and bronze".

decisions.choice: ask him about his peace and bless him: greet and congratulate him
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:10: asking after someone's peace is the usual greeting, and blessing someone can mean congratulating him on success.

decisions.choice: a man of wars of Tou: one who was often at war with Tou
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:10, Hadadezer was Tou's regular enemy, so David's victory freed Tou from a dangerous neighbor.

decisions.choice: all [kinds of] articles (Literal); Hadoram brought (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The closing words have no verb; they describe what the prince brought as gifts. Balanced and Readable say so, as in 2 Samuel 8:10, and Readable calls the articles gifts.

decisions.choice: Hadorão; todos [os tipos de] objetos (L), todo tipo de objetos (B), presentes (R)
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:10 in Portuguese, with Chronicles' "Hadorão" for "Jorão" (m1), the usual Brazilian form, and the closing list as Chronicles has it: no "na sua mão", gold before silver, "all" kinds; Balanced and Readable supply "levou" as 2 Samuel does.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:10 copied, with Hadoram "ሀዶራም" (as Genesis 10:27) for Samuel's Joram "ዮራም", and the gifts as Chronicles lists them, without a verb at Literal
decisions.reason: Chronicles names the son Hadoram and has "and all articles of gold and silver and bronze" where Samuel has "in his hand were articles of silver, gold and bronze".

decisions.choice: "Гадорам"
decisions.reason: Chronicles names the son Hadoram where 2 Samuel 8:10 has Joram (m1).

source.text: גַּם־אֹתָ֗ם הִקְדִּ֞ישׁ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִיד֙ לַיהוָ֔ה עִם־הַכֶּ֨סֶף֙ וְהַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשָׂ֖א מִכָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם מֵֽאֱד֤וֹם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵֽק׃

records.literal_gloss: Also them dedicated the king David to Yahweh with the silver and the gold which he carried off from all the nations: from Edom and from Moab and from [the] sons of Ammon and from [the] Philistines and from Amalek.

en.L: These also King David dedicated to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, with the silver and the gold that he had carried off from all the nations: from Edom and from Moab and from the sons of Ammon and from the Philistines and from Amalek.
en.B: King David dedicated these also to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as he had done with the silver and gold he had carried off from all the nations: from Edom, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines and Amalek.
en.R: King David gave these gifts to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} too, along with the silver and gold he had taken from all the nations. These nations were Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia and Amalek.

es.L: También estos los consagró el rey David {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, con la plata y el oro que había tomado de todas las naciones: de Edom y de Moab y de los hijos de Amón y de los filisteos y de Amalec.
es.B: El rey David consagró también estos objetos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como había hecho con la plata y el oro que había tomado de todas las naciones: de Edom, Moab, los amonitas, los filisteos y Amalec.
es.R: El rey David también le dio estos regalos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, junto con la plata y el oro que había tomado de todas las naciones. Esas naciones eran Edom, Moab, Amón, Filistea y Amalec.

fr.L: Ceux-là aussi, le roi David les consacra {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, avec l’argent et l’or qu’il avait emportés de toutes les nations : d’Édom, et de Moab, et des fils d’Ammon, et des Philistins, et d’Amalek.
fr.B: Le roi David les consacra eux aussi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, comme il l’avait fait de l’argent et de l’or qu’il avait emportés de toutes les nations : d’Édom, de Moab, des Ammonites, des Philistins et d’Amalek.
fr.R: Le roi David a aussi donné ces cadeaux {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, avec l’argent et l’or qu’il avait pris à toutes les nations. Ces nations étaient Édom, Moab, Ammon, les Philistins et Amalek.

sw.L: Hivyo pia mfalme Daudi akamwekea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakfu, pamoja na fedha na dhahabu aliyochukua kutoka mataifa yote: kutoka Edomu na kutoka Moabu na kutoka kwa wana wa Amoni na kutoka kwa Wafilisti na kutoka Amaleki.
sw.B: Mfalme Daudi alimwekea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakfu vitu hivyo pia, kama alivyofanya kwa fedha na dhahabu aliyochukua kutoka mataifa yote: kutoka Edomu, Moabu, Waamoni, Wafilisti na Amaleki.
sw.R: Mfalme Daudi alimtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} zawadi hizo pia, pamoja na fedha na dhahabu aliyokuwa amechukua kutoka mataifa yote. Mataifa hayo yalikuwa Edomu, Moabu, Amoni, nchi ya Wafilisti na Amaleki.

vi.R: Vua Đa-vít cũng dâng những món quà ấy cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cùng với bạc và vàng vua đã lấy được từ mọi dân tộc. Các dân tộc ấy là Ê-đôm, Mô-áp, Am-môn, Phi-li-tin và A-ma-léc.

pt.L: Também a estes o rei Davi consagrou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, com a prata e o ouro que tinha levado de todas as nações: de Edom, e de Moabe, e dos filhos de Amom, e dos filisteus, e de Amaleque.
pt.B: O rei Davi também consagrou esses objetos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, como tinha feito com a prata e o ouro que tinha levado de todas as nações: de Edom, de Moabe, dos amonitas, dos filisteus e de Amaleque.
pt.R: O rei Davi também deu esses presentes {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, junto com a prata e o ouro que tinha tomado de todas as nações. Essas nações eram Edom, Moabe, Amom, a Filístia e Amaleque.

am.L: እነዚህንም ደግሞ ንጉሡ ዳዊት ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ ከወሰደው ብርና ወርቅ ጋር {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ቀደሳቸው፤ [የወሰደውም] ከኤዶምና ከሞዓብ፣ ከአሞን ልጆችና ከፍልስጥኤማውያን፣ ከአማሌቅም ነበረ።
am.B: ንጉሡ ዳዊት ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ፣ ከኤዶም፣ ከሞዓብ፣ ከአሞናውያን፣ ከፍልስጥኤማውያንና ከአማሌቅ የወሰደውን ብርና ወርቅ እንደ ቀደሰ እነዚህንም ደግሞ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ቀደሳቸው።
am.R: ንጉሡ ዳዊት እነዚህን ስጦታዎች ደግሞ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ሰጠ፤ ከሕዝቦች ሁሉ የወሰደውን ብርና ወርቅም ጨምሮ ሰጠ። እነዚህም ሕዝቦች ኤዶም፣ ሞዓብ፣ አሞን፣ ፍልስጥኤምና አማሌቅ ነበሩ።

hi.L: इन्हें भी राजा दाऊद ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए पवित्र करके अर्पित किया, उस चाँदी और सोने के साथ जो वह सब जातियों से उठा लाया था: एदोम से, और मोआब से, और अम्मोन के पुत्रों से, और पलिश्तियों से, और अमालेक से।
hi.B: राजा दाऊद ने इन्हें भी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को अर्पित कर दिया, जैसे उसने उन सब राष्ट्रों से लाई हुई चाँदी और सोना अर्पित किया था: एदोम, मोआब, अम्मोनियों, पलिश्तियों और अमालेक से।
hi.R: राजा दाऊद ने ये भेंटें भी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को दे दीं, उस चाँदी और सोने के साथ जो उसने सब राष्ट्रों से लिया था। ये राष्ट्र थे: एदोम, मोआब, अम्मोन, पलिश्ती और अमालेक।

ru.L: И их тоже посвятил царь Давид {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вместе с серебром и золотом, которое он унёс от всех народов: от Едома, и от Моава, и от сынов Аммона, и от филистимлян, и от Амалика.
ru.B: Царь Давид посвятил и их {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, как посвятил серебро и золото, которое он забрал у всех народов: у Едома, Моава, аммонитян, филистимлян и Амалика.
ru.R: Царь Давид отдал и эти подарки {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}, вместе с серебром и золотом, которые он взял у всех народов. Это были Едом, Моав, Аммон, филистимляне и Амалик.

uk.L: Їх також цар Давид присвятив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} разом зі сріблом і золотом, яке він забрав від усіх народів: від Едому, і від Моаву, і від синів Аммона, і від филистимлян, і від Амалека.
uk.B: Цар Давид присвятив і їх {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, як зробив і зі сріблом та золотом, яке забрав від усіх народів: від Едому, Моаву, аммонітян, филистимлян і Амалека.
uk.R: Цар Давид віддав і ці дари {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}, разом зі сріблом і золотом, яке він забрав від усіх народів. Це були Едом, Моав, Аммон, Филистія й Амалек.

decisions.choice: dedicated: set apart as holy, given over for the LORD's use
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:11. The metal became the LORD's property, kept for his house (verse 8; 1 Kings 7:51). David gives the spoils to the LORD, who gave him the victories (verses 6 and 13).

decisions.choice: differences from 2 Samuel 8:11-12
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:11-12 says the silver and gold "he dedicated" from the nations, where Chronicles says "he carried off"; it lists Aram where Chronicles has Edom (see the note at 2 Samuel 8:12, where the two names differ by one easily confused letter); and it adds "the plunder of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah". Here the two verses are one.

decisions.choice: the Ammonites, the Philistines (Balanced); Ammon, Philistia (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "the sons of Ammon", the Hebrew way of naming that people, as in 2 Samuel 8:12. Readable names the lands, as it does there, and makes the list its own sentence.

decisions.choice: tinha levado (L, B); Edom for Arã
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:11-12 in Portuguese ("consagrou" at Literal and Balanced, "deu" at Readable; "os filhos de Amom" / "os amonitas" / "Amom"), with Chronicles' changes (m2): "tinha levado" for "tinha consagrado", "Edom" in place of "Arã", and no spoil of Hadadezer.

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:11-12 kept for the shared words; "carried off" ("ከወሰደው") and Edom "ኤዶም" for Aram follow Chronicles, without the spoil of Hadadezer
decisions.reason: Samuel has "which he had dedicated from all the nations he subdued", lists Aram first and adds the spoil of Hadadezer; Chronicles has "which he carried off" and Edom.

decisions.choice: "Едом" in the list; "унёс"
decisions.reason: Chronicles lists Edom where 2 Samuel 8:12 has Aram, and says "carried off" where Samuel says "dedicated" (m2).

decisions.choice: Abishai son of Zeruiah struck Edom, where 2 Samuel 8:13 has David making a name by striking Aram
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:13 says "David made a name when he returned from striking Aram in the Valley of Salt, 18,000". Chronicles names the commander who won the battle, Abishai, and the enemy as Edom, which fits the Valley of Salt and the next verse (see the note at 2 Samuel 8:13 on Aram and Edom). The title of Psalm 60 (60:2) credits Joab with 12,000 of Edom in the same valley. The king is credited with what his commanders won, and the different counts may reflect different parts of the campaign.

decisions.choice: Abishai, Joab's brother; the Valley of Salt, near Edom
decisions.reason: Abishai was a son of David's sister Zeruiah and a brother of Joab (2:16; 1 Samuel 26:6). The Valley of Salt lay south of the Dead Sea, toward Edom (2 Kings 14:7).

decisions.choice: 18,000 [men] (Literal); 18,000 Edomites (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 2 Samuel 8:13: Literal brackets the word the number needs; Balanced and Readable join the number to the people.

decisions.choice: Abishai ... Edomu
decisions.reason: Chronicles names Abishai and Edom where 2 Samuel 8:13 names David and Aram; the Swahili follows Chronicles.

decisions.choice: Abisai, filho de Zeruia, feriu Edom
decisions.reason: Chronicles names Abisai and Edom where 2 Samuel 8:13 has David making a name by striking Aram (m1), so only "no vale do Sal, dezoito mil [homens]" (L) and "matou dezoito mil ... no vale do Sal" (B, R) are kept from 2 Samuel in Portuguese. "Abisai" as the shared list for 1 Samuel.

decisions.choice: not copied from 2 Samuel 8:13: Abishai son of Zeruiah strikes Edom; only "በጨው ሸለቆ" and "18,000" are shared
decisions.reason: Samuel has David making a name when he returned from striking Aram; Chronicles names Abishai and Edom. Abishai "አቢሳ" and Zeruiah "ጽሩያ" as in Samuel.

decisions.choice: "अबीशै" and "एदोम"
decisions.reason: Here Chronicles names Abishai and Edom, where 2 Samuel 8:13 has David and Aram; the Hindi follows the Chronicles Hebrew. "अबीशै" and "सरूयाह" as in 2 Samuel.

decisions.choice: "Авесса, сын Саруи"; "Едом", "едомитяне"
decisions.reason: Chronicles gives the victory to Abishai and over Edom, where 2 Samuel 8:13 has David making a name over Aram (m1); "Соляная долина" stays as in Samuel.

source.text: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם בֶּֽאֱדוֹם֙ נְצִיבִ֔ים וַיִּהְי֥וּ כָל־אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑יד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־דָּוִ֔יד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he put in Edom garrisons, and became all Edom servants to David; and saved Yahweh David in all that he went.

en.L: And he put garrisons in Edom, and all Edom became servants to David. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} saved David wherever he went.
en.B: He stationed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave David victory wherever he went.
en.R: David put groups of soldiers in Edom, and all the Edomites came under his rule. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} made David win wherever he went.

es.L: Y puso guarniciones en Edom, y todo Edom llegó a ser siervo de David. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} salvaba a David dondequiera que iba.
es.B: Estableció guarniciones en Edom, y todos los edomitas quedaron sometidos a David. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le daba la victoria a David dondequiera que iba.
es.R: David puso grupos de soldados en Edom, y todos los edomitas quedaron bajo su dominio. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hacía que David ganara dondequiera que iba.

fr.L: Et il mit des garnisons en Édom, et tout Édom devint serviteur de David. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sauva David partout où il alla.
fr.B: Il plaça des garnisons en Édom, et tous les Édomites furent soumis à David. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donna la victoire à David partout où il alla.
fr.R: David a installé des groupes de soldats en Édom, et tous les Édomites sont passés sous son autorité. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait gagner David partout où il allait.

sw.L: Akaweka vikosi vya askari katika Edomu, na Edomu wote wakawa watumishi wa Daudi. Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwokoa Daudi kila alikokwenda.
sw.B: Aliweka vikosi vya askari katika Edomu, na Waedomu wote wakawa chini ya Daudi. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Daudi ushindi kila alikokwenda.
sw.R: Daudi aliweka vikundi vya askari katika Edomu, na Waedomu wote wakawa chini ya utawala wake. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimfanya Daudi ashinde kila alikokwenda.

vi.L: Ông đặt các đồn binh tại Ê-đôm, và toàn thể Ê-đôm trở thành đầy tớ của Đa-vít. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giải cứu Đa-vít bất cứ nơi nào ông đi.
vi.B: Ông đặt các đồn binh tại Ê-đôm, và toàn dân Ê-đôm phải thần phục Đa-vít. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho Đa-vít chiến thắng bất cứ nơi nào ông đi.
vi.R: Đa-vít đặt các toán lính đóng tại Ê-đôm, và toàn dân Ê-đôm phải chịu sự cai trị của ông. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho Đa-vít thắng trận bất cứ nơi nào ông đi.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 에돔에 수비대를 두었고, 온 에돔이 다윗의 종이 되었다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗이 가는 모든 곳에서 그를 구원하셨다.
ko.B: 그는 에돔에 수비대를 두었고, 온 에돔 사람들이 다윗에게 굴복했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 다윗이 가는 곳마다 그에게 승리를 주셨다.
ko.R: 다윗은 에돔 곳곳에 군대를 두어 지키게 했다. 그래서 에돔 사람들은 모두 다윗의 다스림을 받게 되었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 다윗이 가는 곳마다 그를 이기게 해 주셨다.

pt.L: E pôs guarnições em Edom, e todo o Edom se tornou escravo de Davi. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} salvava Davi por onde quer que ele fosse.
pt.B: Ele colocou guarnições em Edom, e todos os edomitas ficaram sujeitos a Davi. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dava vitória a Davi por onde quer que ele fosse.
pt.R: Davi colocou grupos de soldados em Edom, e todos os edomitas ficaram sob o seu domínio. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} fazia Davi vencer por onde quer que ele fosse.

am.L: በኤዶምም የጦር ሰፈሮችን አኖረ፤ ኤዶምም ሁሉ የዳዊት ባሪያዎች ሆኑ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ዳዊትን በሄደበት ሁሉ አዳነው።
am.B: በኤዶም የጦር ሰፈሮችን አቆመ፤ ኤዶማውያንም ሁሉ ለዳዊት ተገዙ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዳዊትን በሄደበት ሁሉ ድል አቀዳጀው።
am.R: ዳዊት በኤዶም የወታደሮች ጭፍሮችን አኖረ፤ ኤዶማውያንም ሁሉ በአገዛዙ ሥር ሆኑ። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ዳዊትን በሄደበት ሁሉ አሸናፊ አደረገው።

hi.L: और उसने एदोम में चौकियाँ बैठाईं, और सारा एदोम दाऊद का दास हो गया। और जहाँ-जहाँ वह गया, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दाऊद को बचाया।
hi.B: उसने एदोम में चौकियाँ बैठाईं, और सब एदोमी दाऊद के अधीन हो गए। दाऊद जहाँ कहीं गया, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे विजय दी।
hi.R: दाऊद ने एदोम में सैनिकों की टुकड़ियाँ बैठा दीं, और सब एदोमी उसके शासन के अधीन आ गए। दाऊद जहाँ भी गया, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उसे जिताया।

ru.L: И поставил он в Едоме гарнизоны, и стал весь Едом рабами Давиду. И спасал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} Давида везде, куда он ни ходил.
ru.B: Он разместил гарнизоны в Едоме, и все едомитяне подчинились Давиду. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} давал Давиду победу везде, куда бы он ни пошёл.
ru.R: Давид поставил отряды воинов в Едоме, и все едомитяне стали подвластны ему. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} давал Давиду победу везде, куда бы он ни пошёл.

uk.L: І поставив він залоги в Едомі, і став увесь Едом рабами Давидові. І {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} рятував Давида скрізь, куди він ходив.
uk.B: Він поставив залоги в Едомі, і всі едомітяни підкорилися Давидові. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} давав Давидові перемогу скрізь, куди він ходив.
uk.R: Давид поставив загони воїнів в Едомі, і всі едомітяни опинилися під його владою. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} давав Давидові перемагати скрізь, куди він ходив.

decisions.choice: garrisons named once, where 2 Samuel 8:14 says it twice
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:14 reads "he put garrisons in Edom; in all Edom he put garrisons". Here it is said once. Edom, Esau's descendants, now serves the line of Jacob, as Genesis 25:23 and 27:29, 40 had said.

decisions.choice: he: David, whose rule the garrisons served
decisions.reason: After verse 12 "he" could refer to Abishai, who won the battle, but the Edomites become David's subjects, and the parallel in 2 Samuel 8:14 means David. Abishai may have done it in his name.

decisions.choice: as in verse 6
decisions.reason: The refrain of verse 6 is repeated: every victory is the LORD's gift.

decisions.choice: subject to David; gave David victory (Balanced); David put; made David win (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 6. Readable names David for "he", following m2.

decisions.choice: guarnições em Edom, said once
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 8:14 in Portuguese, with the garrisons named once, as Chronicles says it (m1).

decisions.choice: parallel 2 Samuel 8:14 copied, with the garrisons named once ("in all Edom" left out)
decisions.reason: Samuel says twice that David put garrisons in Edom; Chronicles says it once.
